title: organic — pave

phrases.translation: 有机质；有机物；有机物质
有机肥；有机肥料；有机质
有机物；有机材料；有机物质
有机高分子；有机聚合物

sentences.sentence: Organic farming is better for the environment.
sentences.translation: 有机耕作对环境更有利。

sentences.sentence: organic gardening
sentences.translation: 有机园艺

sentences.sentence: She looked at the street names, trying to orient herself.
sentences.translation: 她看看街名，试图确定自己的方位。

sentences.sentence: People who had heard the evidence at the trial were surprised at the outcome.
sentences.translation: 在审判过程中听过证词的人都对此结果感到吃惊。

sentences.sentence: outdated teaching methods
sentences.translation: 不合时宜的教学方法

sentences.sentence: a factory with outdated equipment
sentences.translation: 设备陈旧的工厂

sentences.sentence: His writing style is now boring and outdated.
sentences.translation: 他的写作风格如今已显得乏味而过时了。

sentences.sentence: She outlived her husband by 20 years.
sentences.translation: 她比她丈夫多活了20年。

sentences.sentence: Flats outnumber houses in this area.
sentences.translation: 这个地区公寓房比独栋房子多。

sentences.sentence: His troops were hopelessly outnumbered.
sentences.translation: 他的军队在数量上远远不及对方。

sentences.sentence: ...companies that outsource IT functions.
sentences.translation: …将信息技术方面的工作外包的公司。

sentences.sentence: The company began looking for ways to cut costs, which led to the decision to outsource.
sentences.translation: 该公司开始寻找降低成本的途径，这使他们决定外包。

sentences.sentence: The advantages of this deal largely outweigh the disadvantages.
sentences.translation: 这笔交易的利远大于弊。

sentences.sentence: Sometimes, they overcharge or don’t build those parts I have been paying for.
sentences.translation: 有时，他们收费过高或者要不给我修我一直在给钱的那些零部件。

sentences.sentence: Some of the boys became overexcited.
sentences.translation: 有些男孩变得兴奋过度了。

sentences.sentence: But the various pros and cons should not blindly overwhelm one another.
sentences.translation: 但是，众多的利弊得失不应盲目的一个压倒另一个。

sentences.sentence: We try not to think about it because it would overwhelm us to an extent that we would just vegetate.
sentences.translation: 我们尽量不去想它，因为在某种我们能够想像到的程度上他会压倒我们。

sentences.sentence: For example, in a situation in which several bystanders need to band together to overwhelm a perpetrator, they will be more likely to act collectively than to act alone.
sentences.translation: 例如, 就有这样一种情况， 在只有几个旁观者需要联合起来才能压倒一个罪犯的情况下, 他们就可能会更多地采取集体行动。

sentences.sentence: How much do I owe you (= often used to show that you want to pay for something )?
sentences.translation: 我该付你多少钱？

sentences.sentence: Some of the more extreme contacts give you "cat eyes" or how about "owl eyes"?
sentences.translation: 一些更酷的隐形眼镜可以给你一双"猫眼"或者是"猫头鹰的眼睛"。

sentences.sentence: A great owl, with yellow sulphurous eyes, called to him by his name, but he made it no answer.
sentences.translation: 一只长着黄色硫磺的巨大眼睛的猫头鹰，呼唤着他的名字，但他没有应答。

phrases.translation: 应急开关；紧急保险按钮

sentences.sentence: Her face distorted in panic.
sentences.translation: 她的脸因恐慌而变相了。

sentences.sentence: The panic-stricken fled in all directions.
sentences.translation: 惊慌的人群向四面八方逃去。

sentences.sentence: They ascribed courage to me for something I did out of sheer panic.
sentences.translation: 由于我纯粹因惊慌而做的事，他们认为我很有勇气。

sentences.sentence: The Koran describes paradise as a place containing a garden of delight.
sentences.translation: 《古兰经》把天堂描绘成一个拥有快乐花园的地方。

sentences.sentence: You can bet that would truly paralyze the flow of credit: Does anyone believe Washington can manage banks?
sentences.translation: 你可以打赌，这会使流动的信贷真正限于瘫痪：真有人相信华盛顿可以经营银行吗？

sentences.sentence: I think we would all agree that it is well worth it, yet many of us still choose to let this innate fear paralyze us and settle into comfortable, secure positions despite being unhappy in them.
sentences.translation: 我想每个人都认同这些东西是值得的，但是我们中许多人尽管对目前处境不甚满意，仍然选择麻痹于内在的恐惧，停滞于安逸，保险的职位。

sentences.sentence: large areas of rough upland pasture
sentences.translation: 大片起伏的山地牧场

sentences.sentence: the lush pastures of the southern counties
sentences.translation: 南部各郡茂盛的牧场

phrases.translation: 流型，流动型态；活动模；流线谱
分布格局，分布类型；分布型式，分布型；分配结构

设计模式；设计范式；设计样式
空间格局，空间形态；分布类型，空间模式
基本模型；衣服基本纸型
辐射方向图，辐射图；辐射高温计

sentences.sentence: Weather patterns have changed in recent years.
sentences.translation: 气候模式近年已经发生了变化。

sentences.sentence: A general pattern began to emerge .
sentences.translation: 一个总体模式开始显现。

sentences.sentence: Their descriptions seemed to follow a set pattern (= always develop in the same way ) .
sentences.translation: 他们的描述似乎依据固定的模式。

sentences.sentence: His behavior fits a pattern of violent acts.
sentences.translation: 他的举动符合暴力行为的模式。

phrases.translation: 踌躇；停下来好好想一想

sentences.sentence: There was a pause while Alice changed the tape.
sentences.translation: 艾丽斯换磁带的时候出现了短暂的停顿。

sentences.sentence: After a long pause , she went on.
sentences.translation: 停了好一会儿，她才继续下去。

sentences.sentence: a paved courtyard
sentences.translation: 地面铺砌过的院子

text:
英语词汇 · 六级 · 第 26 单元

organic
音标：英 /ɔ:ˈgænɪk/  美 /ɔr'gænɪk/
adj. 有机的
短语：organic matter — 有机质；有机物；有机物质
短语：organic synthesis — [化]有机合成
短语：organic chemistry — 有机化学
短语：organic solvent — 有机溶剂
短语：organic pollutants — 有机污染物
短语：organic acid — 有机酸
短语：organic compound — n. 有机化合物
短语：organic food — 有机食品，有机食物
短语：organic carbon — 有机碳
短语：organic fertilizer — 有机肥；有机肥料；有机质
短语：organic waste — 有机废物；生化废物
短语：organic material — 有机物；有机材料；有机物质
短语：organic silicon — 有机硅
短语：organic substance — 有机物；有机物质
短语：organic glass — 有机玻璃
短语：organic agriculture — 有机农业
短语：organic phase — 有机相
短语：organic polymer — 有机高分子；有机聚合物
短语：organic pigment — 有机颜料
短语：total organic carbon — 总有机碳
例句：Organic farming is better for the environment.
有机耕作对环境更有利。
例句：organic gardening
有机园艺

orient
音标：英 /'ɔ:rɪənt/  美 /'orɪənt/
v. 使适应，使确定方向
短语：orient express — 东方快车
例句：She looked at the street names, trying to orient herself.
她看看街名，试图确定自己的方位。

outcome
音标：英 /ˈaʊtkʌm/  美 /'aʊt'kʌm/
n. 结果
短语：possible outcome — 可能结果
短语：therapeutic outcome — 治疗结果
短语：learning outcome — 学习结果；学习成果
例句：People who had heard the evidence at the trial were surprised at the outcome.
在审判过程中听过证词的人都对此结果感到吃惊。

outdated
音标：英 /ˌaʊtˈdeɪtɪd/  美 /'aʊt'detɪd/
adj. 过时的
例句：outdated teaching methods
不合时宜的教学方法
例句：a factory with outdated equipment
设备陈旧的工厂
例句：His writing style is now boring and outdated.
他的写作风格如今已显得乏味而过时了。

outlive
音标：英 /ˌaʊt'lɪv/  美 /,aʊt'lɪv/
v. 比……活的时间长
例句：She outlived her husband by 20 years.
她比她丈夫多活了20年。

outnumber
音标：英 /ˌaʊt'nʌmbə(r)/  美 /'aʊt'nʌmbɚ/
v. 超过
例句：Flats outnumber houses in this area.
这个地区公寓房比独栋房子多。
例句：His troops were hopelessly outnumbered.
他的军队在数量上远远不及对方。

outsource
音标：英 /ˈaʊtsɔ:s/  美 /'aʊtsɔrs/
v. 外包
例句：...companies that outsource IT functions.
…将信息技术方面的工作外包的公司。
例句：The company began looking for ways to cut costs, which led to the decision to outsource.
该公司开始寻找降低成本的途径，这使他们决定外包。

outweigh
音标：英 /ˌaʊt'weɪ/  美 /'aʊt'we/
v. 超过
例句：The advantages of this deal largely outweigh the disadvantages.
这笔交易的利远大于弊。

overcharge
音标：英 /ˌəʊvə'tʃɑ:dʒ/  美 /,ovɚ'tʃɑrdʒ/
v. 多收钱
例句：Sometimes, they overcharge or don’t build those parts I have been paying for.
有时，他们收费过高或者要不给我修我一直在给钱的那些零部件。

overexcited
音标：英 /ˌəʊvərɪkˈsaɪtɪd/
adj. 过于激烈的
例句：Some of the boys became overexcited.
有些男孩变得兴奋过度了。

overwhelm
音标：英 /ˌəʊvə'welm/  美 /,ovɚ'wɛlm/
v. 压倒，战胜
例句：But the various pros and cons should not blindly overwhelm one another.
但是，众多的利弊得失不应盲目的一个压倒另一个。
例句：We try not to think about it because it would overwhelm us to an extent that we would just vegetate.
我们尽量不去想它，因为在某种我们能够想像到的程度上他会压倒我们。
例句：For example, in a situation in which several bystanders need to band together to overwhelm a perpetrator, they will be more likely to act collectively than to act alone.
例如, 就有这样一种情况， 在只有几个旁观者需要联合起来才能压倒一个罪犯的情况下, 他们就可能会更多地采取集体行动。

owe
音标：英 /əʊ/  美 /o/
v. 欠钱
例句：How much do I owe you (= often used to show that you want to pay for something )?
我该付你多少钱？

owl
音标：英 /aʊl/  美 /aʊl/
n. 猫头鹰
短语：night owl — 猫头鹰；熬夜的人
例句：Some of the more extreme contacts give you "cat eyes" or how about "owl eyes"?
一些更酷的隐形眼镜可以给你一双"猫眼"或者是"猫头鹰的眼睛"。
例句：A great owl, with yellow sulphurous eyes, called to him by his name, but he made it no answer.
一只长着黄色硫磺的巨大眼睛的猫头鹰，呼唤着他的名字，但他没有应答。

panic
音标：英 /'pænɪk/  美 /'pænɪk/
adj. 恐慌的
短语：no panic — [美国俚语]不大高明；平凡
短语：panic disorder — 惊恐性障碍，恐慌症
短语：in panic — 惊慌的
短语：panic attack — 惊恐发作（一种病症）
短语：financial panic — 金融恐慌；经济恐慌
短语：panic button — 应急开关；紧急保险按钮
短语：panic buying — 抢购，恐慌性抢购
例句：Her face distorted in panic.
她的脸因恐慌而变相了。
例句：The panic-stricken fled in all directions.
惊慌的人群向四面八方逃去。
例句：They ascribed courage to me for something I did out of sheer panic.
由于我纯粹因惊慌而做的事，他们认为我很有勇气。

paradise
音标：英 /'pærədaɪs/  美 /'pærə'daɪs/
n. 天堂
短语：paradise lost — 失乐园
短语：a paradise on earth — 人间天堂
短语：fool's paradise — 幻想；虚幻的乐境
短语：paradise island — 天堂岛
短语：earthly paradise — 地上乐园，人间天堂
短语：bird of paradise — 极乐鸟；天堂鸟
例句：The Koran describes paradise as a place containing a garden of delight.
《古兰经》把天堂描绘成一个拥有快乐花园的地方。

paralyze
音标：英 /'pærəlaɪz/  美 /'pærə,laɪz/
v. 瘫痪，麻痹
例句：You can bet that would truly paralyze the flow of credit: Does anyone believe Washington can manage banks?
你可以打赌，这会使流动的信贷真正限于瘫痪：真有人相信华盛顿可以经营银行吗？
例句：I think we would all agree that it is well worth it, yet many of us still choose to let this innate fear paralyze us and settle into comfortable, secure positions despite being unhappy in them.
我想每个人都认同这些东西是值得的，但是我们中许多人尽管对目前处境不甚满意，仍然选择麻痹于内在的恐惧，停滞于安逸，保险的职位。

pasture
音标：英 /'pɑ:stʃə(r)/  美 /'pæstʃɚ/
n. 牧场
短语：put out to pasture — 放牧
短语：pasture land — 牧场
短语：pasture grass — 牧草
例句：large areas of rough upland pasture
大片起伏的山地牧场
例句：the lush pastures of the southern counties
南部各郡茂盛的牧场

pattern
音标：英 /'pætn/  美 /'pætɚn/
n. 模式
短语：pattern recognition — 模式识别
短语：growth pattern — 生长模型；生长模式
短语：flow pattern — 流型，流动型态；活动模；流线谱
短语：distribution pattern — 分布格局，分布类型；分布型式，分布型；分配结构
短语：pattern design — n. 模型设计，图案设计
短语：regular pattern — 正规图样，正常模式
短语：design pattern — 设计模式；设计范式；设计样式
短语：sentence pattern — 句型；句子模式
短语：spatial pattern — 空间格局，空间形态；分布类型，空间模式
短语：pattern matching — 模式匹配
短语：basic pattern — 基本模型；衣服基本纸型
短语：pattern classification — 模式分类
短语：behavior pattern — 行为范型
短语：diffraction pattern — 衍射图样；绕射图
短语：production pattern — 生产纸样；生产形态
短语：economic pattern — 经济模式；经济结构
短语：fringe pattern — 条纹图形，干涉图样
短语：consumption pattern — 消费模式，消费形式
短语：radiation pattern — 辐射方向图，辐射图；辐射高温计
短语：speckle pattern — 散斑图；斑纹图样
例句：Weather patterns have changed in recent years.
气候模式近年已经发生了变化。
例句：A general pattern began to emerge .
一个总体模式开始显现。
例句：Their descriptions seemed to follow a set pattern (= always develop in the same way ) .
他们的描述似乎依据固定的模式。
例句：His behavior fits a pattern of violent acts.
他的举动符合暴力行为的模式。

pause
音标：英 /pɔ:z/  美 /pɔz/
n. 暂停，迟疑
短语：pause and ponder — 踌躇；停下来好好想一想
短语：give pause to — vt. 使人踌躇
短语：pause button — 暂停键；暂停按钮
例句：There was a pause while Alice changed the tape.
艾丽斯换磁带的时候出现了短暂的停顿。
例句：After a long pause , she went on.
停了好一会儿，她才继续下去。

pave
音标：英 /peɪv/  美 /pev/
v. 铺路
短语：pave the way for — 为…做好准备；为…铺平道路
短语：pave the way — 为...作准备；为...铺平道路
短语：paved with good intentions — 充满着善意的
例句：a paved courtyard
地面铺砌过的院子
